[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.03x) + Movement reliability assessment: Normal volume, moderate reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase: maintaining wait-and-see, observing the support at KRW 100,000 and resistance at KRW 110,910.
